verdict.rationale: Sentry publishes an official, first-party MCP server at mcp.sentry.dev. It connects AI assistants to Sentry for searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, reading docs, and managing projects. Connections can be scoped to an organization or project, and the docs cover setting it up from agent conversations; MCP access is even listed on the free pricing tier. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as documented.
